name: 15 Minute Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in your wok until smoking
Add the chicken , the 1 tbsp of seasoning mix , and after they get going , squeeze 1 / 2 the lime inches stir fry until barely done , remove to the side and keep warm
In the same wok , heat another little tad of oil if you need to and stir fry the onions and peppers with the 1 tsp of seasoning
When they're done to your liking , mix in the chicken and squeeze the other 1 / 2 of the lime in and mix up well
Serve with the tortillas and the other fixings and enjoy !
